NetSimR: Actuarial Functions for Non-Life Insurance Modelling

Source: R/NetSimR.R
NetSimR-package.Rd

The NetSimR package provides seven categories of functions:

  1. Capped means, Exposure and ILF curves from various severity distributions, and the special functions behind them

  2. Pure IBNR and UPR earned periods

  3. Sliced distributions

  4. Frequency-severity claims simulation, and applying a reinsurance layer to simulated claims

  5. Claims reserving: chain ladder with Mack's standard errors, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Benktander, Cape Cod and a bootstrap

  6. Excess of loss pricing: burning cost, Pareto rating, exposure rating with MBBEFD curves, and the technical premium

  7. Shiny apps for simulating claims, fitting distributions, fitting GLMs, reserving and reinsurance pricing

Function names

The older functions have CamelCase names (ParetoCappedMean); each also has a snake_case name, the same function, as the newer functions are named (pareto_capped_mean). Both work.
